title: Refresh header uses a protocol-relative target
description: The Refresh header names a protocol-relative target (//host/path). Browsers resolve it against the current scheme, so the navigation leaves the origin while the value itself carries no scheme for a reviewer or a filter to notice. The rule is distinct from DPK-DAST-094 (absolute Refresh target) and DPK-DAST-110 (plaintext Refresh target): here the value is cross-origin only after resolution.
remediation: Use a path-relative Refresh target (a single leading slash) or an absolute https URL on an allow-listed host. Do not accept a Refresh value from request input.
limitation: One Refresh value. The rule does not resolve the target, follow the navigation, or judge whether the destination is trusted.
